native-update-offset-v1.name: offset_probe
native-update-offset-v1.brief: Revise the supplied existing native offset_probe/run mode. It currently adds 1 to every integer from a runtime values_path JSON file. Change that target mode to add 7, preserving input order and exact integer values, including empty arrays, negatives and arbitrary-size integers. Reject malformed JSON, non-array roots and every non-integer element (booleans and floats are not integers), with honest native failure and no adjusted.json in a fresh failed run. Each successful invocation writes exactly {"values":[...]} to adjusted.json under its own RunContext.workdir. Preserve package identity offset_probe, mode identity run, the values_path runtime knob, and the unrelated offset_probe/identity mode's behavior and declaration. Keep the supplied original project byte-for-byte unchanged: deliver the revised same-identity candidate in this isolated run, preserve its full baseline record, and run actual original/revised regression tests. Add or update a truthful README with native discovery, validation, runtime invocation and ordinary examples, and generate SKILL.md through native export. Use the full Create workflow, genuine human strategy approval and all normal independent review/completion gates. Work stays local; do not modify framework, installed packages or another project and do not publish a PR. The operator's separate variant capability checker is unavailable during authoring and runs after delivery; use actual independently designed local tests without claiming that checker passed. This is a native variant case, not the booking56 benchmark.

native-plugin-reverse-v1.name: reverse_plugin
native-plugin-reverse-v1.brief: Create a standalone reusable native Package named reverse_plugin with one intentionally unscored model-free Mode named run. Read each invocation's declared string runtime knob text_path as an external UTF-8 JSON file whose root must be a string. Write exactly {"text": reversed_string} into text.json under that invocation's RunContext.workdir. Reverse Unicode code points exactly, preserving whitespace, newlines and empty strings; do not trim, normalize, coerce or bake an example into the code. Malformed JSON or any non-string root must fail honestly with no text.json in a fresh failed run. Deliver the standalone Package directory, truthful README, independently designed local tests and a generated native SKILL.md. The actual native plugin mechanism is registry add/import copy into a separate consumer project, qualified discovery/resolve/validation, actual installed-mode execution, and registry remove cleanup. Verify that complete consumer lifetime through real commands with unchanged standalone source bytes. There is no foreign factory.plugins/Python entry-point loader in this native mapping; do not invent one, install globally or change registry/framework source. Follow the full Create workflow, genuine human strategy approval, independent QA, Overwatch, documentation and final completion gates. Keep all generated work local with no PR/publication. The operator's separate variant capability checker is unavailable during authoring and runs after delivery; local tests must use the public contract and must not claim that hidden checker passed. This is a native plugin case, not the booking56 benchmark.
